thread:
Priya Kapoor: CS-4698 inbound from FinMap 10; they9re seeing intermittent 502s and spikes in p95 latency from hosted inference in eu-south AZ4 since ~08:45 UTC. Multiple customer requests failing.

Carlos Mendes: I9m seeing short bursts of egress packet loss on eus4 edge around 08:42-09:05 UTC. Loss windows ~6-14% and some high retransmit counts on our proxy host.

Maya Chen: Telemetry correlates to TCP retransmits and SYN/FIN anomalies. Path to provider ASN 64521 shows ECMP-induced reordering + occasional asymmetric drops.

Jun Park: FinMap provided curl traces and a small pcap. They get 502 from our gateway proxy; some requests succeed after retries.

Priya Kapoor: Customer excerpt:
> curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
> initial handshake succeeds, then requests hang and proxy returns 502.

Carlos Mendes: mtr from edge -> provider next-hop: loss jumps at hop 5, RTT variance up. Opening carrier ticket TRK-EUS4-99 and attaching traceroutes.

Maya Chen: Model cache status question: is the model family FinMap uses replicated in AZ2/AZ3? Cold-cache penalty if we move them.

Jun Park: Yes, model shards present in AZ2/AZ3, but first requests will hit cache-warm penalty ~30-110ms depending on shard.

Priya Kapoor: FinMap wants minimal impact. Offer: allow region-fallback for non-latency-critical routes and keep critical endpoints pinned to AZ4 while we mitigate.

Carlos Mendes: Carrier initial reply: "observed microbursts on PE output queues causing short drops; investigating link shaping and optics." ETA 40-70m.

Jun Park: Short mitigation plan: 1) Canary steer small % of FinMap traffic to AZ2, 2) If stable, expand; 3) Apply temporary connection throttles to new sockets terminating in AZ4.

Maya Chen: Kicking 3% canary to AZ2 now.

NetMonBot: Canary shift applied: 3% -> eu-south-az2 at 08:55:12 UTC.

Carlos Mendes: Canary looks clean: canary 5xx ~0, AZ4 remaining slice still elevated.

Priya Kapoor: FinMap confirms some calls on canary route are OK, but they still see failures on their stricter SLAs.

Jun Park: Increasing to 20% at 09:05 UTC. Monitoring p50/p95 latency and 5xx.

Maya Chen: Alert created: eus4_egress_loss > 5% for duration > 3m. Dashboard annotated with carrier ticket TRK-EUS4-99.

Carlos Mendes: Carrier update at 09:20 UTC: applied output buffer tuning and per-flow pacing on PE facing our trunk; seeing drop rate fall near 09:17 UTC.

Priya Kapoor: Customer reports reduced errors at 09:25 UTC. Offering 3% credit window for impacted interval and documenting fallback opt-in.

Jun Park: Rolling remaining FinMap non-critical traffic off the affected provider at 09:30 UTC and throttling new persistent connections into AZ4 proxies.

deploy-bot: Smart-router policy change deployed at 09:30:46 UTC (commit: f7e8d9c).

Maya Chen: Summary: root cause appears to be provider-side short microbursts and ECMP reordering on AS64521 trunk causing stalled TCP sessions -> proxy 502/504. Mitigation: carrier queue tuning + our route-steer.

Priya Kapoor: Marking customer escalation resolved at 09:35 UTC; keeping incident open until carrier confirms full remediation. Sending closure note to FinMap.

Jun Park: Postmortem action items: (1) Implement automated failover for provider loss thresholds, (2) Improve warm-cache path for AZ fallback to reduce cold penalty, (3) Update CS playbook for region-fallback opt-in and credit offers.

Carlos Mendes: Evidence uploaded: s3://redwood-incidents/eus4/1763205555/edge-packets-clip.pcap and edge-logs.tar.gz

Maya Chen: Owners assigned: Carlos -> carrier follow-up & evidence pack, Jun -> routing automation, Priya -> customer closure & credits, Maya -> alerting/dashboard updates.

Priya Kapoor: Thanks team :thumbsup: 10 I'll file the PM and send the FinMap closure message.
